newsitem.title: USA: US prompt jet drops with futures, diffs firm a bit.
newsitem.headline: US prompt jet drops with futures, diffs firm a bit.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices dropped moderately Thursday afternoon tracking NYMEX futures, partially offset in the Gulf Coast by firming differentials linked to buying by majors, traders said.

"Two majors who are normally on the sell side came in and picked up barrels," one Gulf player said, noting diffs on back second-cycle 54-grade jet firmed about 0.15 cent to about 2.75 cents under February futures.
New York 54-grade, meanwhile, saw diffs widen a smidgen to about 1.90 cents above the screen, players said.
((- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1632))
